lessons.lesson: A persistent bearish sweep in a SHORT-GAMMA name with a live bullish catalyst (e.g. IPO access) + a fundamentals VETO is a trap: a ZGL *reclaim* squeezes UP. Respect the veto and the bear's strongest point -- do not even carry defined-risk bearish premium into an undated bullish catalyst.
Reinforced by HOOD 2026-06-05 (LOSS, +31% against): a DIVERGENT flow↔chart read is not a directional trade. The watch-only / 0% directional decision was correct here.
